name: Vase
material: earthenware with slip coating and painted decoration
dimensions: Diameter of mouth: 14 cm (5 1/2 in.); Overall: 20.4 cm (8 1/16 in.)
summary: This Neolithic Chinese vessel has an ovoid body with two handles. Its neck is short and splays outward into a wide opening. It is decorated with a continuous lozenge motif. The material is a fine, reddish-buff clay slightly polished and then painted in black and red.
